required_fixes: Live BrowserGym 1280x720 CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree with AX>10 must be operational (playwright, browsergym-core, agentlab >=0.3 installed and verified via census 4 envs x3 retries) before any confirmatory live claim can be made. Current run used synthetic fallback exclusively.

Honest-cost permutation |rho_shuffled| must be strictly <0.20 for ALL pipelines (p>=0.20). Current max 0.23038 (H-HIERARCHICAL-CF, p=0.176) exceeds frozen threshold. Within-f std>0 and diff=0 confirm not bijective n*3200, but |rho|<0.20 is a hard gate per spec.json:decision_rule and prereg.md §7.

PC-OPENAPI-COVERAGE must demonstrate >=70% task path coverage on ACTUAL WebArena-Verified v2 / WebGym 300k task paths, not synthetic /random/alias* fixture paths. Current fetch_manifest shows 14 spec paths covering synthetic prefix /random only.

PC-ROUTING-DIFF must demonstrate >=20% before!=after routing normalization pairs on ACTUAL task-relevant path templates, not synthetic extra pairs. Current routing_manifest shows 14/58 pairs differ but only 6/40 task-relevant (/v2/items->/items, /v1/orders->/orders, /v3/audit->/audit, /api/v2/data->/api/data, /api/v3/data->/api/data, /v2/audit->/audit).

Compilation IR must be built from and executed against live CDP Accessibility trees (AX>10), not synthetic ax_nodes 15-29 hash fallback. Current compilation_ir_manifest shows workflows but no evidence of live DOM/AX ingestion.

Endpoint catalog must cluster centroids from live OpenAPI spec enums and real observed header/body/auth_scope components, not synthetic fixture. Current endpoint_catalog_manifest centroids reference synthetic alias paths only.

Joint composition manifest shows selection_log: [] and complementary_frac: 0.0, indicating the joint multi-candidate set cover was not exercised as described (adaptive k=2-3 covering header+body+query+auth jointly). Must verify joint pipeline logic on live heterogeneous tasks.
validity_findings: LIVE SUBSTRATE ABSENT: The experiment claims to test on 'live heterogeneous WebArena-Verified v2/WebGym 300k sample where OpenAPI spec covers >=70% task paths and routing normalization differs before/after on >=20% task-relevant paths' (spec.json:question, prereg.md §1). However, provenance.json:census_log confirms BrowserGym census 4 envs x3 retries ALL FAILED with 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named browsergym'. live_available=False, census_available=False, synthetic_fallback_disclosed=True. The entire primary confirmatory shootout ran on synthetic fixture sha 83b7c52d only.

PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH HARD FAILURE: Per frozen falsifier (spec.json:falsifier, prereg.md §7), 'MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any PC fails (PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH...)'. Producer correctly reports PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH pass=false. This alone mandates MEASUREMENT_INVALID regardless of pooled metrics.

PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY HARD FAILURE: Per frozen falsifier, 'MEASUREMENT_INVALID if... honest_cost != sum counters+browser_steps+compile/fetch (jitter/f*6.0) or |rho_shuffled|>=0.20 p<0.20'. Producer reports perm rho max 0.23038 (p=0.176) exceeding |rho|<0.20. While diff=0 and within-f std=1.02 confirm not bijective n*3200/f*6.0, the |rho|<0.20 gate is absolute per prereg.md §7: 'If S1-S5 pass but S6 fails... result is MIXED not SURVIVES' for economics, but 'MEASUREMENT_INVALID if... |rho_shuffled|>=0.20 p<0.20' is a separate hard gate. Producer correctly flags MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

SPEC COVERAGE GATE NOT MET ON TASK PATHS: PC-OPENAPI-COVERAGE passes (spec fetch 200 OK, 14 paths, prefix_covered 40/40) but ONLY on synthetic /random/alias* prefix. The Director mandate requires 'OpenAPI spec covers >=70% task paths' on WebArena/WebGym task paths. No WebArena/WebGym task paths were tested. The fetch_manifest spec paths (/api/data, /api/users, /v2/items, /v1/orders, /admin/settings, /api/reports, /v3/audit, /random/alias0-3/data) do not correspond to any verified WebArena-Verified v2 or WebGym 300k task paths.

ROUTING DIFF GATE NOT MET ON TASK-RELEVANT PATHS: PC-ROUTING-DIFF reports 14/58 pairs differ before!=after, but only 6 pairs are task-relevant templates (/v2/items, /v1/orders, /v3/audit, /api/v2/data, /api/v3/data, /v2/audit). The remaining 8 are synthetic /random/alias-* and /random/mixed-* paths. 6/40 = 15% < 20% required threshold on actual task paths.

COMPILATION IR NOT EXERCISED ON LIVE AX: compilation_ir_manifest.json shows 4 workflows (header, body, auth, mixed) with DSM 99% compression, stable locator ranking, deterministic JSON IR 5-8 steps, Shanghai HITL patchable flags, lazy heal null selectors. However, raw_evidence.json shows ax_nodes 15-29 (synthetic hash fallback) and compression_ratio 0.99 for all B-COMPILED-DSM entries. No live CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree ingestion occurred. The IR was built from synthetic fixture, not live heterogeneous DOM.

ENDPOINT CATALOG NOT EXERCISED ON LIVE SPEC: endpoint_catalog_manifest.json shows 51 centroids with Jaccard>=0.6 clustering over method/path/header/body/auth_scope, but all centroids reference synthetic alias-* and random/* paths. No live WebArena/WebGym OpenAPI spec enums were ingested. The catalog is a synthetic fixture artifact.

JOINT COMPOSITION NOT OPERATIONAL: joint_manifest.json shows selection_log: [] and complementary_frac: 0.0, meaning the adaptive 2-3 candidate complementary set cover (header+body+query+auth jointly) was never triggered. The B-JOINT-FETCH 40/40=1.0 result appears to derive from synthetic derived_context containing expected_bound verbatim (as parent handoff do_not_assume warns: 'synthetic derived_context may contain expected bound verbatim observationally saturated, complementary_frac 0.0 and selection_log empty').

SYNTHETIC-TO-REAL GAP UNBRIDGED: All pooled metrics (0.500 for all single-candidate pipelines, 1.000 for joint) replicate parent EXP-FRONTIER-35915275774 synthetic ceiling exactly. The 14-streak tunnel on C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE persists because the live heterogeneous substrate mandated by Director PIVOT was not achieved.

HONEST COST INSTRUMENTATION CONFIRMED VALID EXCEPT RHO: honest_cost == sum counters+browser_steps+compile/fetch/spec/joint holds (diffs max 0). extra_jitter counters appear in some pipelines (2 units) but do not affect sum. Within-f std >0 for all pipelines (min 1.02). Not bijective with n*3200. Only |rho|<0.20 gate fails marginally.

CONTROLS PASS EXCEPT TWO HARD GATES: All NCs pass (NC-NO-APPLICABLE, NC-EMPTY, NC-ORACLE-LEAK, NC-STAGEHAND-ISOLATION, NC-BIJECTIVE-COST). PCs pass except PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH and PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY. PC-COMPILATION-DSM-BUILT, PC-ENDPOINT-CATALOG-BUILT, PC-HIERARCHICAL-BUILT, PC-FLAT-HEALTH, PC-OPENAPI-COVERAGE, PC-ROUTING-DIFF, PC-CONFIDENCE-DERIVED, PC-FRESHNESS-NONCIRCULAR, PC-AX-CDP all pass per producer, but the first three are validated on synthetic fixtures only.
baseline_findings: B-EXACT-MATCH-CF: 20/40=0.500 Wilson [0.352,0.648] binom p=1.9e-10. Expected 0/40 on alias-OOD under correct-family gating but got 10/10 header + 10/10 body = 20/40. This indicates the synthetic fixture family structure (header/body families 0-1) allows exact match on verbatim intent for those families, but auth/mixed families (2-3) are 0/10. The exact-match baseline is not a pure 0/40 null as spec.json:baselines claims.

B-FLAT-TFIDF-K5-CF: 20/40=0.500 identical to exact-match. McNemar vs exact-match p=1.0, vs hierarchical p=1.0, vs compiled p=1.0, vs endpoint p=1.0. All single-candidate pipelines are indistinguishable on synthetic fixture.
H-HIERARCHICAL-CF: 20/40=0.500 identical. hierarchical_manifest.json shows 84 themes, 168 episodes, but per-family breakdown shows header 10/10, body 10/10, auth 0/10, mixed 0/10 — same ceiling.
B-COMPILED-DSM: 20/40=0.500 identical. compilation_ir_manifest proves genuine DSM 99% IR structure but execution on synthetic ax_nodes yields no gain over flat.
B-ENDPOINT-CATALOG: 20/40=0.500 identical. endpoint_catalog_manifest proves genuine Jaccard>=0.6 centroids (51) covering header/body/query/auth families but retrieval on synthetic yields no gain.

B-JOINT-FETCH: 40/40=1.000 Wilson [0.912,0.912]. Per-family header 10/10, mixed 10/10. ECE 0.110. However, joint_manifest complementary_frac=0.0 and selection_log=[] indicate this is not a genuine complementary set cover rescue but likely synthetic observation saturation (parent handoff do_not_assume).
claim_ceiling: The experiment does not test the Director-mandated question on live heterogeneous WebArena-Verified v2/WebGym 300k with genuine OpenAPI spec coverage >=70% task paths and routing diff >=20% task-relevant paths. It replicates the prior synthetic-only bounded ceiling (20/40=0.500 pooled, 0/10 auth, 0/10 mixed for all single-candidate pipelines under correct-family gating and honest cost) on fixture sha 83b7c52d. The joint composition 40/40=1.0 on synthetic is not validated live and shows complementary_frac=0.0, selection_log=[], consistent with parent handoff do_not_assume warning about synthetic observation saturation. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains at EXPERIMENTAL synthetic ceiling (21/40=0.525 / 20/40=0.500) with NO live validation. The 14-streak tunnel persists. No claim about O(1) compilation vs endpoint-catalog vs hierarchical vs flat on live heterogeneous AX can be supported or falsified by this run. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is the only justified status.
